narrationTexts: Two real bugs, confirmed by comments in the code itself. Fixing both.
finalText:
**Build's clean, 0 errors.**

Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage, not the deprecation noise:

- `resolveRetries` in [options.js](src/core/options.js) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed the field name.
- `isBackoffEnabled` in [retryPolicy.js](src/net/retryPolicy.js) threw on `undefined` flags. The new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`, so I treat `undefined` as disabled.

The remaining warnings are just deprecation noise from the bump, `8 warnings, 0 errors` now.
